# Add volume-based pricing tiers to usage dimensions

Usage dimensions need an optional `tiers` array so high-volume usage can be billed at different unit prices. Each tier uses string fields `tierPosition`, `upperBound`, optional `tierName`, and optional `unitPrice`; `upperBound` is a numeric string or `"inf"`. Bounds must increase without overlap, align to `usageIncrement`, and leave `"inf"` only at the end. Every tier after the first requires `unitPrice`; an omitted first-tier price represents a free tier.

Tiered dimensions are mutually exclusive with `usageEntitlement`, `consumptionPrice`, and `overageAllowed: true`. Creation, update, and read APIs must validate, persist, replace, clear with `tiers: null`, and return the same tier objects. Billing must sort by numeric `tierPosition`, allocate usage across the inclusive bounds, divide quantities by `usageIncrement`, preserve price precision and currency conversion, and produce a distinct line item per consumed tier. Append `tierName` to the normal line-item name when present. Existing non-tiered dimensions and invoice behavior must remain unchanged.

One legacy case is especially important: a dimension with no `tiers`, no `consumptionPrice`, and no `usageEntitlement` is valid and contributes no invoice line items. Do not make tier support turn that unpriced dimension into an error or a synthetic charge.

Verify with:

    cd /app && npm run build && npm run test:ci -- --runInBand

688:     async processBilling(
689:         startDateOverride: Date,

694:         invoiceDateOverride?: string,
695:         offeringUpgrade?: boolean,
696:     ): Promise<string> {
697:         const { endTime, startTime, subscriptionEnd, subscriptionStart } = Billing.billingCycleToTimeRange(
698:             this.billingCycle,
699:         );
700:         const startDate = startDateOverride ? startDateOverride : DatetimeUtils.beginningOfDay(new Date(startTime));
701:         const endDate = endDateOverride ? endDateOverride : DatetimeUtils.endOfDay(new Date(endTime));
702: 
703:         const lineItems = new InvoiceLineItems();
704:         let exchangeRate = 1;
705:         if (Offering.getCurrency({ customer, offering: this }) !== SupportedCurrencies.USD) {
706:             exchangeRate = await AnalyticsService.getExchangeRate({
707:                 currency: Offering.getCurrency({ customer, offering: this }),
708:             });

710:                 `Invoice dynamically calculated with realtime currency exchange rate €${exchangeRate.toFixed(
711:                     2,

715:         if (calculateSubscription && !this.freeTrialEndDate) {
716:             // If the customer is not currently in a free trial
717:             Subscription.logger.log(
718:                 `subscription start: ${subscriptionStart},  subscription end: ${subscriptionEnd}. No free trial`,
719:             );
720:             this.calculateSubscriptionLineItem({
721:                 lineItems,
722:                 startDate: offeringUpgrade
723:                     ? new Date()
724:                     : DatetimeUtils.beginningOfDay(new Date(startDateOverride ? startDate : subscriptionStart)),
725:                 endDate: DatetimeUtils.endOfDay(new Date(subscriptionEnd)),
726:                 negative: false,
727:                 exchangeRate,
728:             });
729:         }
730:         if (calculateSubscription && this.freeTrialEndDate) {
731:             // If the customer is currently in a free trial
732:             if (
733:                 DatetimeUtils.dateIsBetweenTwoDates(
734:                     DatetimeUtils.endOfDay(new Date(subscriptionEnd)),
735:                     DatetimeUtils.beginningOfDay(new Date(startDateOverride ? startDate : subscriptionStart)),
736:                     new Date(this.freeTrialEndDate),
737:                 )
738:             ) {
739:                 Subscription.logger.log(
740:                     `free trial end date: ${this.freeTrialEndDate},  subscription end: ${subscriptionEnd}. Usage is negated for the whole subscription period`,
741:                 );
742:                 // The customer is currently in a free trial and it extends through the subscription time
743:                 this.calculateSubscriptionLineItem({
744:                     lineItems,
745:                     startDate: DatetimeUtils.beginningOfDay(
746:                         new Date(startDateOverride ? startDate : subscriptionStart),
747:                     ),
748:                     endDate: DatetimeUtils.endOfDay(new Date(subscriptionEnd)),
749:                     negative: true,
750:                     exchangeRate,
751:                 });
752:                 this.calculateSubscriptionLineItem({
753:                     lineItems,
754:                     startDate: DatetimeUtils.beginningOfDay(
755:                         new Date(startDateOverride ? startDate : subscriptionStart),
756:                     ),
757:                     endDate: DatetimeUtils.endOfDay(new Date(subscriptionEnd)),
758:                     negative: false,
759:                     exchangeRate,
760:                 });
761:             } else if (
762:                 DatetimeUtils.dateIsBetweenTwoDates(
763:                     new Date(this.freeTrialEndDate),
764:                     DatetimeUtils.beginningOfDay(new Date(startDateOverride ? startDate : subscriptionStart)),
765:                     DatetimeUtils.endOfDay(new Date(subscriptionEnd)),
766:                 )
767:             ) {
768:                 // If the customer is in a free trial but it ends before the end of the subscription period
769:                 Subscription.logger.log(
770:                     `Free trial is in the current billing cycle: ${this.freeTrialEndDate}, ${new Date(
771:                         subscriptionEnd,
772:                     ).toISOString()}`,
773:                 );
774:                 this.calculateSubscriptionLineItem({
775:                     lineItems,
776:                     startDate: DatetimeUtils.beginningOfDay(
777:                         new Date(startDateOverride ? startDate : subscriptionStart),
778:                     ),
779:                     endDate: new Date(this.freeTrialEndDate),
780:                     negative: true,
781:                     exchangeRate,
782:                 });
783:                 this.calculateSubscriptionLineItem({
784:                     lineItems,
785:                     startDate: DatetimeUtils.beginningOfDay(
786:                         new Date(startDateOverride ? startDate : subscriptionStart),
787:                     ),
788:                     endDate: new Date(this.freeTrialEndDate),
789:                     negative: false,
790:                     exchangeRate,
791:                 });
792:             } else {
793:                 // Free trial is in the past billing cycle
794:                 this.calculateSubscriptionLineItem({
795:                     lineItems,
796:                     startDate: offeringUpgrade
797:                         ? new Date(startDateOverride ? startDate : subscriptionStart)
798:                         : DatetimeUtils.beginningOfDay(new Date(startDateOverride ? startDate : subscriptionStart)),
799:                     endDate: DatetimeUtils.endOfDay(new Date(subscriptionEnd)),
800:                     negative: false,
801:                     exchangeRate,
802:                 });
803:             }
804:         }
805: 
806:         if (calculateUsage) {
807:             // If there is a free trial end date in the past billing cycle, negate the usage for the free trial period
808:             if (
809:                 this.freeTrialEndDate &&
810:                 DatetimeUtils.dateIsBetweenTwoDates(new Date(this.freeTrialEndDate), startDate, endDate)

817:                     lineItems,
818:                     negative: true,

821:                     customerService: this.customerService,
822:                     offeringInstance: this,
823:                     dimensions: this.dimensions,

825:             } else if (
826:                 this.freeTrialEndDate &&
827:                 DatetimeUtils.dateIsBetweenTwoDates(endDate, startDate, new Date(this.freeTrialEndDate))
828:             ) {
829:                 // The customer is currently in a free trial

831:                     startDate,

833:                     customer,
834:                     lineItems,
835:                     negative: true,
836:                     businessID: this.businessID,
837:                     customerId: this.customerId,

842:             }

847:                 customer,
848:                 lineItems,
849:                 businessID: this.businessID,
850:                 customerId: this.customerId,
851:                 customerService: this.customerService,
852:                 negative: false,
853:                 offeringInstance: this,
854:                 dimensions: this.dimensions,
855:             });
856:         }
857:         if (this?.discount?.name) {

859:                 Offering.addDiscountLineItem(this.discount, lineItems);

862:         const invoiceResponse = await this.invoicesService.create({

275:     static async getLineItemsForUsage({
276:         startDate,
277:         endDate,
278:         customer,
279:         lineItems,
280:         negative,
281:         businessID,
282:         customerId,
283:         customerService,

287:         startDate: Date;
288:         endDate: Date;
289:         customer?: ReadCustomerResponseData;
290:         lineItems: InvoiceLineItems;
291:         negative?: boolean;

294:         customerService: CustomerService;

310:         const aggregateUsageData = usage?.data as AggregatedUsageResponse[];
311: 
312:         const dimensionMap = dimensions.reduce((acc, dimension) => {
313:             acc[dimension.dimensionId] = dimension;
314:             return acc;
315:         }, {}) as Record<string, ReadDimensionResponseData>;
316:         const dimensionTotals = aggregateUsageData.reduce((acc, usageElement) => {
317:             const { dimensionId } = usageElement;
318: 
319:             const total = Billing.usageToTotal(usageElement, dimensionMap[dimensionId]);
320: 
321:             if (acc[dimensionId]) {
322:                 acc[dimensionId] += parseFloat(total);
323:                 acc[dimensionId] = acc[dimensionId].toFixed(2);
324:             } else {
325:                 acc[dimensionId] = parseFloat(total);
326:                 acc[dimensionId] = acc[dimensionId].toFixed(2);
327:             }
328: 
329:             return acc;
330:         }, {}) as Record<string, number>;
331:         let exchangeRate = 1;
332: 
333:         if (Offering.getCurrency({ customer, offering: offeringInstance }) !== SupportedCurrencies.USD) {
334:             console.log('Inside exchange rate');
335:             exchangeRate = await AnalyticsService.getExchangeRate({
336:                 currency: Offering.getCurrency({ customer, offering: offeringInstance }),

340:                     2,
341:                 )} = $1.00`,
342:             );
343:         }
344: 
345:         Object.keys(dimensionTotals).forEach((dimensionId) => {
346:             const dimension = dimensionMap[dimensionId];
347:             const { tiers } = dimension;
348:             const totalUsage = dimensionTotals[dimensionId] as number;
349: 
350:             if (tiers && tiers.length > 0) {
351:                 const sortedTiers = [...tiers].sort((a, b) => parseInt(a.tierPosition, 10) - parseInt(b.tierPosition, 10));
352:                 let remainingUsage = totalUsage;
353:                 let lowerBound = 0;
354: 
355:                 for (const tier of sortedTiers) {
356:                     const upperBound = tier.upperBound === 'inf' ? Infinity : parseFloat(tier.upperBound);
357:                     const tierUsage = Math.max(0, Math.min(remainingUsage, upperBound - lowerBound));
358:                     
359:                     if (tierUsage > 0) {
360:                         const unitPrice = tier.unitPrice ? parseFloat(tier.unitPrice) : 0;
361:                         const unitCost = Number(
362:                             (unitPrice * exchangeRate).toFixed(
363:                                 Offering.getDecimalsForNumber(unitPrice) === 0 ? 2 : Offering.getDecimalsForNumber(unitPrice),
364:                             ),
365:                         );
366:                         
367:                         const shouldDisplayLineItem = Billing.determineIfLineItemShown({
368:                             Offering: offeringInstance,
369:                             dimension,
370:                             totalUsage: tierUsage,
371:                             unitCost,
372:                             freeDimensionOnInvoice: offeringInstance.settings?.freeDimensionOnInvoice,
373:                         });
374: 
375:                         if (shouldDisplayLineItem) {
376:                             const {
377:                                 usageIncrement,
378:                                 consumptionUnit: { unit, type },
379:                             } = dimension;
380: 
381:                             const { displayName, total: displayTotal } = InvoiceLineItem.prepareLineItem({
382:                                 total: tierUsage,
383:                                 dimensionType: type,
384:                                 dimensionId,
385:                                 dimensionName: dimension.dimensionName,
386:                                 offeringName: offeringInstance.offeringName,
387:                                 usageIncrement: parseInt(usageIncrement),
388:                                 dimensionUnit: unit,
389:                                 negative,

392:                             const lineItemName = tier.tierName ? `${displayName} - ${tier.tierName}` : displayName;
393:                             lineItems.addLineItem(new InvoiceLineItem(lineItemName, displayTotal, unitCost));
394:                         }
395:                     }
396: 
397:                     remainingUsage -= tierUsage;
398:                     lowerBound = upperBound;
399:                     
400:                     if (remainingUsage <= 0) {
401:                         break;
402:                     }
403:                 }
404:             } else {
405:                 if (dimension.consumptionPrice === undefined || dimension.consumptionPrice === null) {
406:                     return;
407:                 }
408:                 const unitCost = Number(
409:                     (parseFloat(dimension.consumptionPrice) * exchangeRate).toFixed(
410:                         Offering.getDecimalsForNumber(parseFloat(dimension.consumptionPrice)) === 0
411:                             ? 2
412:                             : Offering.getDecimalsForNumber(parseFloat(dimension.consumptionPrice)),
413:                     ),
414:                 );
415:                 const shouldDisplayLineItem = Billing.determineIfLineItemShown({
416:                     Offering: offeringInstance,
417:                     dimension,
418:                     totalUsage,
419:                     unitCost,
420:                     freeDimensionOnInvoice: offeringInstance.settings?.freeDimensionOnInvoice,
421:                 });
422:                 if (shouldDisplayLineItem) {
423:                     const {
424:                         usageIncrement,
425:                         consumptionUnit: { unit, type },

427: 
428:                     const { displayName, total: displayTotal } = InvoiceLineItem.prepareLineItem({
429:                         total: totalUsage,

432:                         dimensionName: dimension.dimensionName,
433:                         offeringName: offeringInstance.offeringName,

275:     static async getLineItemsForUsage({
276:         startDate,
277:         endDate,
278:         customer,
279:         lineItems,
280:         negative,
281:         businessID,
282:         customerId,
283:         customerService,
284:         dimensions,
285:         offeringInstance,
286:     }: {
287:         startDate: Date;
288:         endDate: Date;
289:         customer?: ReadCustomerResponseData;
290:         lineItems: InvoiceLineItems;
291:         negative?: boolean;
292:         businessID: string;
293:         customerId: string;
294:         customerService: CustomerService;
295:         dimensions: ReadOfferingResponseData['dimensions'];
296:         offeringInstance: Offering;
297:     }): Promise<InvoiceLineItems> {
298:         const usage = await customerService.findUsageForCustomer(
299:             {
300:                 businessID,
301:                 customerId,
302:                 customer,
303:             },
304:             {
305:                 startTime: startDate.toISOString(),
306:                 endTime: endDate.toISOString(),
307:             },
308:         );
309: 
310:         const aggregateUsageData = usage?.data as AggregatedUsageResponse[];
311: 
312:         const dimensionMap = dimensions.reduce((acc, dimension) => {
313:             acc[dimension.dimensionId] = dimension;
314:             return acc;
315:         }, {}) as Record<string, ReadDimensionResponseData>;
316:         const dimensionTotals = aggregateUsageData.reduce((acc, usageElement) => {
317:             const { dimensionId } = usageElement;
318: 
319:             const total = Billing.usageToTotal(usageElement, dimensionMap[dimensionId]);
320: 
321:             if (acc[dimensionId]) {
322:                 acc[dimensionId] += parseFloat(total);
323:                 acc[dimensionId] = acc[dimensionId].toFixed(2);
324:             } else {
325:                 acc[dimensionId] = parseFloat(total);
326:                 acc[dimensionId] = acc[dimensionId].toFixed(2);
327:             }
328: 
329:             return acc;
330:         }, {}) as Record<string, number>;
331:         let exchangeRate = 1;
332: 
333:         if (Offering.getCurrency({ customer, offering: offeringInstance }) !== SupportedCurrencies.USD) {
334:             console.log('Inside exchange rate');
335:             exchangeRate = await AnalyticsService.getExchangeRate({
336:                 currency: Offering.getCurrency({ customer, offering: offeringInstance }),
337:             });
338:             lineItems.addTerms(
339:                 `Invoice dynamically calculated with realtime currency exchange rate €${exchangeRate.toFixed(
340:                     2,
341:                 )} = $1.00`,
342:             );
343:         }
344: 
345:         Object.keys(dimensionTotals).forEach((dimensionId) => {
346:             const dimension = dimensionMap[dimensionId];
347:             const { tiers } = dimension;
348:             const totalUsage = dimensionTotals[dimensionId] as number;
349: 
350:             if (tiers && tiers.length > 0) {
351:                 const sortedTiers = [...tiers].sort((a, b) => parseInt(a.tierPosition, 10) - parseInt(b.tierPosition, 10));
352:                 let remainingUsage = totalUsage;
353:                 let lowerBound = 0;
354: 
355:                 for (const tier of sortedTiers) {
356:                     const upperBound = tier.upperBound === 'inf' ? Infinity : parseFloat(tier.upperBound);
357:                     const tierUsage = Math.max(0, Math.min(remainingUsage, upperBound - lowerBound));
358:                     
359:                     if (tierUsage > 0) {
360:                         const unitPrice = tier.unitPrice ? parseFloat(tier.unitPrice) : 0;
361:                         const unitCost = Number(
362:                             (unitPrice * exchangeRate).toFixed(
363:                                 Offering.getDecimalsForNumber(unitPrice) === 0 ? 2 : Offering.getDecimalsForNumber(unitPrice),
364:                             ),
365:                         );
366:                         
367:                         const shouldDisplayLineItem = Billing.determineIfLineItemShown({
368:                             Offering: offeringInstance,
369:                             dimension,
370:                             totalUsage: tierUsage,
371:                             unitCost,
372:                             freeDimensionOnInvoice: offeringInstance.settings?.freeDimensionOnInvoice,
373:                         });
374: 
375:                         if (shouldDisplayLineItem) {
376:                             const {
377:                                 usageIncrement,
378:                                 consumptionUnit: { unit, type },
379:                             } = dimension;
380: 
381:                             const { displayName, total: displayTotal } = InvoiceLineItem.prepareLineItem({
382:                                 total: tierUsage,
383:                                 dimensionType: type,
384:                                 dimensionId,
385:                                 dimensionName: dimension.dimensionName,
386:                                 offeringName: offeringInstance.offeringName,
387:                                 usageIncrement: parseInt(usageIncrement),
388:                                 dimensionUnit: unit,
389:                                 negative,
390:                             });
391: 
392:                             const lineItemName = tier.tierName ? `${displayName} - ${tier.tierName}` : displayName;
393:                             lineItems.addLineItem(new InvoiceLineItem(lineItemName, displayTotal, unitCost));
394:                         }
395:                     }
396: 
397:                     remainingUsage -= tierUsage;
398:                     lowerBound = upperBound;
399:                     
400:                     if (remainingUsage <= 0) {
401:                         break;
402:                     }
403:                 }
404:             } else {
405:                 if (dimension.consumptionPrice === undefined || dimension.consumptionPrice === null) {
406:                     return;
407:                 }
408:                 const unitCost = Number(
409:                     (parseFloat(dimension.consumptionPrice) * exchangeRate).toFixed(
410:                         Offering.getDecimalsForNumber(parseFloat(dimension.consumptionPrice)) === 0
411:                             ? 2
412:                             : Offering.getDecimalsForNumber(parseFloat(dimension.consumptionPrice)),
413:                     ),
414:                 );
415:                 const shouldDisplayLineItem = Billing.determineIfLineItemShown({
416:                     Offering: offeringInstance,
417:                     dimension,
418:                     totalUsage,
419:                     unitCost,
420:                     freeDimensionOnInvoice: offeringInstance.settings?.freeDimensionOnInvoice,
421:                 });
422:                 if (shouldDisplayLineItem) {
423:                     const {
424:                         usageIncrement,
425:                         consumptionUnit: { unit, type },
426:                     } = dimension;
427: 
428:                     const { displayName, total: displayTotal } = InvoiceLineItem.prepareLineItem({
429:                         total: totalUsage,
430:                         dimensionType: type,
431:                         dimensionId,
432:                         dimensionName: dimension.dimensionName,
433:                         offeringName: offeringInstance.offeringName,
434:                         usageIncrement: parseInt(usageIncrement),
435:                         dimensionUnit: unit,
436:                         negative,
437:                     });
438:                     lineItems.addLineItem(new InvoiceLineItem(displayName, displayTotal, unitCost));
439:                 }
440:             }
441:         });
442: 
443:         return lineItems;
444:     }
